Title: Unwholesome Bond, Angelo, "Circle of One", New Blood and Circle

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Can Angelo target one uncontrolled Angelo (i.e any single "circle of one" vampire) when playing superior Unwholesome Bond?

Can Angelo target multiple uncontrolled Angelos (i.e consider multiple "circle of one" vampires as part of the same circle) when playing superior Unwholesome Bond?

Does Angelo´s "as if" ability overrule the ruling ( [LSJ 20020609] ) of "circle of one" which state that no more than one vampire can be part of a "circle of one"?

Can New Blood choose to join a "circle of one"?

Are all vampires considered to belong to a "circle of one" (i.e. belonging to a circle is not a Blood Brother exclusive trait) as long as they aren´t identified with a particular circle?

Unwholesome Bond

Angelo

New Blood

Rulebook

> Circle: Each Blood Brother is identified with a particular circle. A vampire without a circle designation is their own circle. Inner Circle is not a Blood Brother circle.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> Can Angelo target one uncontrolled Angelo (i.e any single "circle of one" vampire) when playing superior Unwholesome Bond?
>
Yes.

> inm8 wrote:
> Can Angelo target multiple uncontrolled Angelos (i.e consider multiple "circle of one" vampires as part of the same circle) when playing superior Unwholesome Bond?
>
No, he must choose which "circle of one" he mimicks. Either "Uncontrolled Angelo #1 circle" or ""Uncontrolled Angelo #2 circle"...

> inm8 wrote:
> Does Angelo´s "as if" ability overrule the ruling ( [LSJ 20020609] ) of "circle of one" which state that no more than one vampire can be part of a "circle of one"?
>
It doesn't overrule this ruling. They are complementary.

> inm8 wrote:
> Can New Blood choose to join a "circle of one"?
>
Yes, because they can choose any circle.

LSJ's ruling should be amended to: "By default, two vampires can never be in the same circle of one (unless an explicit effect allow you to join a circle of one)."

> inm8 wrote:
> Are all vampires considered to belong to a "circle of one" (i.e. belonging to a circle is not a Blood Brother exclusive trait) as long as they aren´t identified with a particular circle?
>
Yes, they are.
